name: Greenboard

soc2_evidence.signal: Homepage states 'Enterprise-grade security and privacy: SOC 2 Type 2 compliant' and links a trust center at trust.greenboard.com

hiring_signals: Founding Account Executive (YC jobs page) - GTM role, no security/infra roles observed
pitch_note: Already SOC 2 Type 2 compliant with a public trust center (trust.greenboard.com), so attestation services are redundant; only angle is annual re-audit or expansion frameworks (17a-4 already in place).

name: Archon

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 claim found for Archon itself in search or on archon.inc; they sell FedRAMP compliance automation to software vendors targeting government (regulated buyers)
YC profile confirms compliance-heavy GovTech positioning (FedRAMP timeline 16->6 months) but lists no SOC 2 attestation of their own

hiring_signals: Founding Engineer, Infrastructure ($130K-$210K) - AWS/Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, FedRAMP/NIST 800-53 responsibilities
aws_evidence: Founding Engineer Infrastructure job posting explicitly lists AWS (alongside Azure) plus Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/archon/jobs/iSDasJM-founding-engineer-infrastructure)
pitch_note: 3-person W25 GovTech compliance startup hiring security and founding-infrastructure engineers with no visible SOC 2 of its own - enterprise/government buyers will demand it; caveat: they are compliance-automation experts themselves and may DIY with their own tooling.

name: Andy AI

soc2_evidence.signal: Site and app listings advertise HIPAA-compliant data handling but no SOC 2 badge or trust page found anywhere
Sells B2B into home health agencies (regulated healthcare buyers) who commonly require SOC 2 in vendor security reviews

aws_evidence: Job posting lists only Python & TypeScript and LLM work; no cloud provider named (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/andy-ai/jobs/lrsiSTP-founding-engineer-healthcare-ai)
pitch_note: Ideal ICP: 5-person healthtech with HIPAA-only posture (no SOC 2 yet), selling to regulated home-health agencies, ~$625K pre-seed, and actively hiring founding engineers - prime timing for a first SOC 2 Type I.

name: Synthio Labs

soc2_evidence.signal: Nov 2025 funding press release describes the platform as 'HIPAA-compliant, SOC2-ready' - ready language, not a completed attestation

hiring_signals: 6 open roles incl. Software Engineer - AI and two Forward Deployed Engineer roles; no dedicated security/GRC/DevOps role listed
pitch_note: 'SOC2-ready' but apparently not yet attested while selling to Top-10 pharma enterprises - a fresh $5M seed and no in-house GRC hire means they likely need an auditor/advisor to convert readiness into an actual Type I/II report.

name: Fuse

soc2_evidence.signal: Public Vanta-style trust center shows SOC 2 framework controls; site states HIPAA and SOC 2 Type II certified

hiring_signals: 0 jobs listed on YC profile (is_hiring false)
pitch_note: Already SOC 2 Type II certified with a live public trust center and not hiring - disqualified except for future re-audit cycles; also London-based, weakening the US-auditor angle.

name: Tivara

soc2_evidence.signal: Website states the platform is 'fully HIPAA and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant'

hiring_signals: Founding Backend Engineer, AI Agents (YC jobs page)
pitch_note: Claims full SOC 2 Type 2 + HIPAA compliance on its homepage despite being a 2-person team - already attested, so only a re-audit or audit-quality upgrade play remains.

name: Brighterway

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 mention found on brighterway.ai or in search results; no public trust page
Processes tens of millions of pages of medical records monthly for workers-comp insurers/physicians - regulated enterprise buyers that require vendor SOC 2

pitch_note: 14-person healthtech handling massive volumes of PHI-laden medical records for insurance-industry buyers, seed-funded (Sep 2024, amount undisclosed) and hiring engineers - no SOC 2 signal anywhere, so vendor security reviews are likely blocking enterprise deals.

name: Blaze

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 or trust page found; consumer P2P stablecoin payments app (US/Mexico), not a B2B vendor subject to enterprise security reviews

hiring_signals: Founding Engineer - stablecoin-powered international payments (React Native/Expo; mentions multi-jurisdiction regulatory compliance)
aws_evidence: Founding engineer posting names React Native/Expo and 'modern backend technologies' but no cloud provider (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/blaze-2/jobs/hCctHAe-founding-engineer-build-the-future-of-stablecoin-powered-international-payments)
pitch_note: Consumer crypto P2P app with no enterprise buyers demanding SOC 2 - money-transmitter licensing, not SOC 2 attestation, is their compliance burden; weak ICP fit despite being lean and hiring.
